title: Account
description: A node in the transaction graph. Combines PaySim identity with DS-2 graph metrics and DS-1/3 ML scores.

in_degree.description: Number of incoming transactions (from DS-2 graph engine).

out_degree.description: Number of outgoing transactions (from DS-2 graph engine).

pattern_count.description: Number of suspicious patterns detected for this account (from DS-2 detectors: circular, fan_out, dense_cluster).

risk_score.description: Combined final score: 0.5 * rule_score + 0.5 * ml_prob * 100 (from DS-1/3).

risk_band.description: Discretized risk band: low (0-30), medium (31-65), high (66-100).
